effects.effect: Whenever a creature within [distance](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/distance) of your [Dramatic Monologue](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.troubadour.level-1/dramatic-monologue) ability makes a [power roll](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/power-roll), you can spend 1 drama as a free [triggered action](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/triggered-action) to use [Dramatic Monologue](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.troubadour.level-1/dramatic-monologue), targeting only one creature.
